svg.title: SQLite task registry schema
svg.text: PK primary key · FK foreign key · UQ unique · JSON stored as TEXT · SQLite WAL + foreign_keys=ON
Activity starts before a final routing decision exists.
Request identity correlates the journal to its later run.
Each operation records started and completed/failed events.
Persist first; stream second. Reload reads the same evidence.
No simulated thinking sequence or private model reasoning.
Chroma upsert → acknowledge only written version
Never mix fixture and live embeddings
index_collections: PK name · model · dimension · summary_version; registers each index namespace for durable new-task scheduling.
FTS5 tasks_fts: title + summary, synchronized by insert/update/delete triggers. Versioned outbox changes in the same SQLite transaction.
Cardinalities and complete column-level relationships: schema.mmd. Executable authority: submission/task_router/schema.sql.
Names are data, not router rules
The usual-place tie is a SQL aggregation over completed receipts. No embedding or execution call is needed to ask the question.
